subject: Private deployment — starter bundle credit and ops/support routing
messages:
From: Claire Benson <claire.benson@elliot-labs.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment question — packaging + onboarding credit?

Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week — impressed with the latency profile on the dedicated pool. We are digging into the commercials with procurement and I have two quick asks from engineering and finance:

1) Can you confirm whether the starter bundle (3-node onprem + platform fee for year one) qualifies for any onboarding or migration credit? Our infra team estimates ~6 weeks of dedicated migration work and would prefer some offset for the platform fee while we validate.

2) For support, we need a clear escalation path and 24/7 oncall for P1 during cutover. Upside: if we agree to a 12-month firm commitment, we can accelerate procurement.

Attached a short requirements PDF. Who should we loop from your side to discuss SOW and implementation credits?

Claire
Claire Benson
CTO, Elliot Labs
--- attachment: elliot_vpc_requirements.pdf (pdf, 72KB)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Benson <claire.benson@elliot-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment question — packaging + onboarding credit?

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the requirements doc. Short answers up front: yes, we can offer a limited onboarding credit against the year-one platform fee for a starter bundle and we can authorize a P1 escalation oncutover with a scoped SRE retainer.

I'll outline a pragmatic option below and Marissa (CS) will jump in with SOW/implementation timing:

Option A (recommended):
- 20% credit on platform fee for first 3 months (applied as invoice credit)
- Included: migration triage (up to 80 engineer-hours) + 30-day hotfix window post cutover
- Support: P1 oncall included for cutover window (first 30 days), then transition to Gold retainer (24/7) if you choose 12-month commit

We typically require a short SOW amendment to formalize the credit and the retainer. Marissa — can you prepare a starter SOW and estimated hours based on the attached requirements?

Claire — happy to jump on a 30-minute call to walk through tradeoffs tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment question — packaging + onboarding credit?

Naomi / Diego — forwarding Claire's ask and Diego's proposed Option A. Quick assessment below and a request for sign-off on the commercial mechanics so I can send a clean SOW to Elliot: 

Summary of ask: 20% platform fee credit for first 3 months, up to 80 migration hours included, 30-day P1 cutover coverage. They will consider a 12-month commit if we give a stronger onboarding concession.

Risk/benefit: Elliot is an enterprise prospect (health analytics), good strategic fit for our VPC playbook in the west coast market. The 20% x 3mo credit equates to ~$45k revenue giveback but accelerates a potential ARR of $1.2M over 12 months if they commit. Migration hours seem reasonable but we should cap at 80 hours and bill any overage.

Decision request for Naomi: Can we approve Option A with two conditional items?
- Condition 1: Credit is applied only after signed SOW + 12-month minimum commit OR 6-month commit with a $25k non-refundable onboarding fee.
- Condition 2: Any migration over 80 hours billed at standard CS rate.

If you prefer, I can propose a 25% credit for 2 months instead — trade narrower discount for faster sign.

Marissa
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear breakdown. I like the economics of Option A given the ARR upside, but I want tighter guardrails on the credit and an explicit deliverable list on the SOW. Approve with the following edits: 

- Approve 18% credit on platform fee, applied across first 2 billing cycles (not 3).
- Approve included migration: up to 60 engineer-hours; additional hours billed at 80% of standard CS list rate for negotiated flexibility.
- Approve 30-day P1 cutover coverage; SRE retainer to take effect on day 31 if commit is signed.
- Condition: Credit clawback if Elliot exercises termination within first 6 months (prorated).

Marissa — update the SOW to call out milestones (pilot, cutover, verification window), the exact credit math, and a short certification checklist that Elliot must sign at the end of the 30-day hotfix window. Once updated, Diego to run the redlines with procurement.

Naomi
VP, Commercial Operations

Hi Claire / procurement team — thanks for the patience while we worked this internally. Per Naomi's guidance we've landed on the commercial mechanics below; attached is the updated SOW draft for review. Key points: 

- Credit: 18% of the monthly platform fee applied as invoice credit across the first two billing cycles after go-live.
- Migration hours: up to 60 engineer-hours included; overage billed at 80% of published CS rate.
- Cutover support: P1 oncall covered for the 30-day hotfix window; starting day 31 the Gold retainer (24/7) is available per the SOW.
- Clawback: prorated clawback if cancellation occurs within 6 months.

Next steps:
1) Elliot to confirm commitment term (12 months preferred) and sign SOW.
2) We will schedule a kickoff within 5 business days of SOW signature.

If that aligns, I'll send a DocuSign link for the SOW and a short order form to lock the seat pricing. Happy to jump on a call if procurement wants to walk through the credit math.

Best,
